Built for one bird on the

The 60 QT.

The dual rack fries

frames.headline:
Measure your oil
with water.
frames.sub: Bird in the empty pot, water to cover it. Take the bird out. That water line is your oil line. Then dump the water and dry the pot.

frames.headline:
Fully thawed.
Patted dry.
Not stuffed.
frames.sub: USDA says 12 pounds or less for a fried turkey. Dry skin means less spatter.

frames.headline:
About 3 to 5
minutes a pound.
frames.sub: Done at 165° in the thickest part of the breast and the innermost thigh and wing. Source: USDA.
